basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Cambridge, UK, who recently dived into the world of PC building. My interests include gaming, particularly Warzone, and exploring new shows on Netflix. I work as a junior IT support technician, which is helping me learn more about tech, but I'm still a newbie when it comes to building and troubleshooting PCs. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 11 PM GMT. I'm single and spend most of my weekends gaming or catching up on my favorite series.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of technology and gaming, mostly self-taught through online tutorials and trial and error. My job in IT support gives me some practical experience, but I'm still learning the ropes of more advanced tech concepts.
